Effect: [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Alphamon] in its name among them to your hand, and place 1 card with [X Antibody] in its traits among them under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card. Trash the rest.
Inherited Effect: [End of Attack] If this Digimon has [Alphamon] in its name, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 5 or less.
